title: Aviation Life Support Marines Hold Pilots’ Lives in Their Hands on MCAS Iwakuni
description: When a pilot is faced with a life or death situation, his lifeline can be found right underneath his seat. Corporal Trevor Phillips learned how aviation life support systems aboard Marine Corps Air Station Iwakuni play a large role in saving a pilot’s life. Includes sound bites from Lance Cpls. Rafael Maldonado and Eileen Dwyer, Flight Equipment Technicians, MALS-12. Also available in high definition.
